evidence: Console.set_window_title writes the OSC 0 title sequence through control, so the output for "hello" is "\x1b]0;hello\x07", matching the reference test expectation (reference tests/test_console.py test_set_console_title).
It returns True only when the control was written and False when not a terminal (rich/console.py:1170-1173), matching the reference contract.
Legacy Windows consoles receive the title via term.set_title (rich/_windows_renderer.py:54-56), as the reference does.
Unsanitized titles containing BEL or ESC are not guarded against, which the reference also does not do. This is an observation, not a deficiency relative to the reference.
